privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Guallet collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our service.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.intro: We collect the following types of information:
section1.accountDataDesc: Name, email address, and password (stored as a secure hash).
section1.financialDataDesc: Account balances, transactions, budgets, and other financial records you choose to enter.
section1.usageDataDesc: Basic analytics such as page visits and feature usage to help us improve the product.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.item1: To provide and maintain the service
section2.item2: To authenticate you and keep your account secure
section2.item3: To send important notifications about your account
section2.item4: To improve and develop new features based on anonymous usage patterns

section3.title: 3. Data Storage and Security
section3.body: Your data is stored in encrypted databases. We implement industry-standard security measures including HTTPS, password hashing, and regular security audits. No system is 100% secure; please also take steps to protect your own account credentials.

section4.title: 4. Data Sharing
section4.body: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal data to third parties. We may share anonymised, aggregated data for analytical purposes. When you connect your bank via open banking, your data is transmitted directly through the provider's secure API — we never store your banking credentials.

section5.title: 5. Cookies
section5.body: We use essential cookies to keep you logged in and to remember your preferences. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

section6.title: 6. Your Rights
section6.item1: Access the personal data we hold about you
section6.item3: Request deletion of your account and associated data
section6.item4: Export your data in a machine-readable format
section6.contact: To exercise any of these rights, please open an issue on our GitHub repository.

section7.title: 7. Open Source
section7.body: Guallet is open source. You can review exactly how your data is handled by reading the source code on GitHub.

section8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
section8.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through a prominent notice in the application.

section9.title: 9. Contact Us
section9.body: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us by opening an issue on GitHub.
